requirements.text: The steering verification test shall be conducted on a level surface affording good adhesion.

requirements.quote: During the test(s), the vehicle shall be loaded to its technically permissible maximum mass and its technically permissible maximum load on the steered axle(s).
requirements.text: During the steering tests the vehicle shall be loaded to its technically permissible maximum mass and its technically permissible maximum load on the steered axle(s).

requirements.quote: all performance tests shall be carried out under conditions of actual or simulated electrical load of all essential systems or systems components which share the same energy supply.
requirements.text: For systems using electrical energy, all steering performance tests shall be carried out under actual or simulated electrical load of all essential systems sharing the same energy supply.

requirements.quote: It shall be possible to leave a curve with a radius of 50 m at a tangent without unusual vibration in the steering equipment
requirements.text: It shall be possible to leave a curve with a radius of 50 m at a tangent without unusual vibration in the steering equipment at 50 km/h for category M1 vehicles.

requirements.quote: During the measurement of control effort, forces with a duration of less than 0.2 seconds shall not be taken into account.
requirements.text: During measurement of steering control effort, forces with a duration of less than 0.2 seconds shall not be taken into account.

requirements.quote: Table 2 Steering control effort requirements
requirements.text: With intact steering the M1 vehicle shall not require a maximum steering control effort above 15 daN to reach a 12 m turning radius within 4 s.

requirements.quote: Maximum permitted steering time and the maximum permitted steering control effort with a failure in the steering equipment are given in the table below
requirements.text: With a failure in the steering equipment the M1 vehicle shall reach a 20 m turning radius with a maximum steering control effort of 30 daN within 4 s.

requirements.quote: The tests shall be performed on a flat, dry asphalt or concrete surface affording good adhesion. The ambient temperature shall be between 0 °C and 45 °C.
requirements.text: The ACSF tests shall be performed on a flat, dry asphalt or concrete surface affording good adhesion with an ambient temperature between 0 °C and 45 °C.

requirements.quote: The width of the lane shall be minimum 3.5 m, for the purpose of the tests of this annex.
requirements.text: For the ACSF tests the lane width shall be a minimum of 3.5 m, unless a narrower lane is agreed and correct function on wider lanes is demonstrated.

requirements.quote: All vehicle speeds specified for the tests described in this annex shall be met within a tolerance of ±2 km/h.
requirements.text: All vehicle speeds specified for the ACSF tests shall be met within a tolerance of ±2 km/h.

requirements.quote: The sampling rate shall be at least 100 Hz.
requirements.text: The raw lateral acceleration data at the vehicle centre of gravity shall be measured with a sampling rate of at least 100 Hz.

requirements.quote: No outside edge of the tyre tread of the vehicle’s front wheel does cross the outside edge of any lane marking.
requirements.text: In the ACSF Category B1 lane keeping functional test, no outside edge of the tyre tread of the vehicle's front wheel shall cross the outside edge of any lane marking.

requirements.quote: During both tests, the optical warning signal was given at the latest 15 s after the steering control has been released and remains until ACSF is deactivated.
requirements.text: In the hands-on transition test the optical warning signal shall be given at the latest 15 s after the steering control is released and remain until the ACSF is deactivated.

requirements.quote: During the lower speed test the acoustic warning signal was given at the latest 30 s after the steering control has been released and remains until ACSF is deactivated.
requirements.text: In the lower speed hands-on test the acoustic warning signal shall be given at the latest 30 s after the steering control is released and remain until the ACSF is deactivated.

requirements.quote: The recorded lateral acceleration does not exceed 1m/s²,
requirements.text: In the Category C lane change functional test the recorded lateral acceleration shall not exceed 1 m/s².

requirements.quote: The test requirements are fulfilled if the measured overriding force does not exceed 50 N, as specified in paragraph 5.6.4.3. above.
requirements.text: In the Category C overriding test the measured force applied by the driver to override the system shall not exceed 50 N.

requirements.quote: The requirements of the test are fulfilled if the system detects the approaching vehicle no later than at the distance declared by the vehicle manufacturer (Srear)
requirements.text: In the Category C sensor performance test the system shall detect the approaching L3 motorcycle no later than at the declared rear detection distance Srear.

requirements.quote: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation, an international approval mark
requirements.text: Every vehicle conforming to a type approved under this Regulation shall bear an international approval mark affixed conspicuously in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form.

requirements.quote: A letter “X” preceding the approval number in the case when either:
requirements.text: The approval mark shall show a letter "X" preceding the approval number where the steering system exhibits functionality defined as ACSF of Category B2, D or E, or where ACSF of Categories A, B1 or C have been exempted from technical requirements.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and shall be indelible.
requirements.text: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.
requirements.text: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.

requirements.quote: a = 8 mm min
requirements.text: The character size of the steering approval mark shall be at least 8 mm.

requirements.quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every vehicle conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.text: An international approval mark shall be affixed to every vehicle conforming to a type approved under this Regulation with regard to electromagnetic compatibility.

requirements.quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.text: The electromagnetic compatibility approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting approval.

requirements.quote: Markings on ESAs in conformity with paragraph 5.3. above need not be visible when the ESA is installed in the vehicle.
requirements.text: Markings on an ESA conforming to the approval mark requirements need not be visible when the ESA is installed in the vehicle.

requirements.quote: a = 6 mm min
requirements.text: The character size of the EMC approval mark shall be at least 6 mm.

requirements.quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements
requirements.text: The vehicle and its electrical/electronic systems or ESAs shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the EMC requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.quote: A vehicle shall be tested for radiated emissions and for immunity to radiated disturbances.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be tested for radiated emissions and for immunity to radiated disturbances.

requirements.quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.text: The ESAs of the ALKS shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions and for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 32 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band and 32 to 43 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: When measured at a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 10.0 ± 0.2 m, the vehicle broadband radiated emission shall not exceed 32 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz band, increase logarithmically to 43 dBµV/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band and remain 43 dBµV/m up to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: When measured at a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 3.0 ± 0.05 m, the vehicle broadband radiated emission shall not exceed 42 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz band, increase to 53 dBµV/m over 75 to 400 MHz and remain 53 dBµV/m up to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: On the vehicle representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.text: On the vehicle representative of its type the measured broadband emission values expressed in dBµV/m shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 28 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 35 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.text: When measured at 10.0 ± 0.2 m, the vehicle narrowband radiated emission shall not exceed 28 dBµV/m in the 30 to 230 MHz band and 35 dBµV/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz band.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 38 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 45 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.text: When measured at 3.0 ± 0.05 m, the vehicle narrowband radiated emission shall not exceed 38 dBµV/m in the 30 to 230 MHz band and 45 dBµV/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz band.

requirements.quote: the field strength shall be 30 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 25 volts/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: The vehicle shall withstand an immunity field strength of 30 V/m over more than 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz band with a minimum of 25 V/m throughout, and 10 V/m over more than 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz band with a minimum of 8 V/m.

requirements.quote: there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions", according to paragraph 2.1. of Annex 6.
requirements.text: During the immunity tests there shall be no degradation of performance of the immunity related functions, including the direct control of the vehicle and the driver warning functions.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz
requirements.text: The ESA broadband radiated emission shall not exceed 62 to 52 dBµV/m over 30 to 75 MHz, decrease to 52 dBµV/m by 75 MHz, rise to 63 dBµV/m over 75 to 400 MHz and remain 63 dBµV/m up to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz
requirements.text: The ESA narrowband radiated emission shall not exceed 52 to 42 dBµV/m over 30 to 75 MHz, rise to 53 dBµV/m over 75 to 400 MHz and remain 53 dBµV/m up to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: Maximum allowed pulse amplitude for
requirements.text: For a 12 V system the transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA on the supply lines shall not exceed a positive pulse amplitude of +75 V and a negative pulse amplitude of -100 V.

requirements.quote: Test Level in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: The ESA shall withstand, over more than 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz band, a test level of 60 V/m in stripline, 75 V/m in TEM cell, 60 mA in BCI, 30 V/m in ALSE below 2 GHz, and 10 V/m in ALSE from 2,000 to 6,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: Minimum Test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: The ESA shall withstand, over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz band, a minimum test level of 50 V/m in stripline, 62.5 V/m in TEM cell, 50 mA in BCI, 25 V/m in ALSE below 2 GHz and 8 V/m in ALSE from 2,000 to 6,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance
requirements.text: The ESA shall be considered as complying with the immunity requirements where during the tests performed according to Annex 9 there is no degradation of performance of immunity related functions.

requirements.quote: Immunity of ESA
requirements.text: For a 12 V system the ESA related to immunity related functions shall withstand pulse 1 at -75 V for 500 pulses with functional status III and pulse 2a at +37 V for 500 pulses with functional status I.

requirements.quote: Test duration / number of pulses
requirements.text: For a 12 V system the ESA related to immunity related functions shall withstand pulses 3a at -112 V and 3b at +75 V each for 1 hour with functional status I.

requirements.quote: Where a vehicle or electrical/electronic system or ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply
requirements.text: Where a vehicle or electrical/electronic system or ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with the narrowband emission requirements.

requirements.quote: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply
requirements.text: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with the radiated immunity requirements.

requirements.quote: RF transmitters shall be tested in the transmit mode.
requirements.text: RF transmitters fitted to the vehicle shall be tested in the transmit mode, with wanted emissions within the necessary bandwidth disregarded and spurious emissions subject to the Regulation.

requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or an outdoor test site (OTS).
requirements.text: The vehicle broadband emission limits shall apply throughout the 30 to 1,000 MHz frequency range for measurements performed in an ALSE or an outdoor test site.

requirements.quote: If peak detectors are used, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
requirements.text: Where peak detectors are used for the broadband emission measurement, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.

requirements.quote: RBW at
requirements.text: The spectrum analyser used for the vehicle broadband emission measurement shall use a 100/120 kHz resolution bandwidth with a minimum scan time of 100 ms/MHz for peak detection and 120 kHz with 20 s/MHz for quasi-peak detection.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made on the left and right sides of the vehicle.
requirements.text: Vehicle broadband emission measurements shall be made on the left and right sides of the vehicle, in both horizontal and vertical polarisation, at the documented antenna positions.

requirements.quote: The ignition switch shall be switched on. The engine shall not be operating.
requirements.text: For the vehicle narrowband emission measurement the ignition switch shall be switched on and the engine shall not be operating.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.text: Vehicle narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.

requirements.quote: The engine shall normally turn the driving wheels at a steady speed of 50 km/h
requirements.text: During the vehicle immunity test the engine shall normally turn the driving wheels at a steady speed of 50 km/h, unless a different condition is agreed.

requirements.quote: ADS shall be operational (1)
requirements.text: During the vehicle immunity test in 50 km/h mode the ADS shall be operational and shall remain in a failure safe mode or expected failure operational mode, with no unexpected warning and no unexpected activation of brake, horn or restraint systems.

requirements.quote: the immunity test shall demonstrate the vehicle stays in a failure safe mode or expected failure operational mode during the test in 50km/h mode or Brake mode.
requirements.text: Where the vehicle is equipped with an ADS, the immunity test shall demonstrate that the vehicle stays in a failure safe mode or expected failure operational mode during the 50 km/h mode or Brake mode test.

requirements.quote: Only non-perturbing equipment shall be used while monitoring the vehicle.
requirements.text: Only non-perturbing equipment shall be used while monitoring the vehicle during the immunity test, with the vehicle exterior and passenger compartment monitored by video camera and microphone.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be exposed to electromagnetic radiation in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges in vertical polarization.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be exposed to electromagnetic radiation in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range in vertical polarisation during the immunity test.

requirements.quote: AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range;
requirements.text: The test signal for the vehicle immunity test shall use AM with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz range, PM2 in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz range and PM3 in the other prescribed ranges.

requirements.quote: the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation
requirements.text: Before or after the main ESA broadband emission test, the measured extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the applicable interference limits.

requirements.quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.text: During the ESA narrowband emission test the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably at maximum load.

requirements.quote: No extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point during calibration.
requirements.text: During calibration of the ESA immunity setup no extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.text: ESA immunity measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.quote: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA
requirements.text: When the bulk current injection method is used, the injection probe shall be positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA with the substitution method, or at 900 mm with the closed loop method.

requirements.quote: Apply the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines
requirements.text: Test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the ESA supply lines and to other connections that may be operationally connected to supply lines.

requirements.quote: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation an international approval mark
requirements.text: Every vehicle conforming to a type approved under this Regulation shall bear an international approval mark affixed conspicuously in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form.

requirements.quote: A circle surrounding the Letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.text: The cyber security approval mark shall comprise a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle
requirements.text: The approval mark shall show the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and shall be indelible.
requirements.text: The cyber security approval mark shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be placed on or close to the vehicle data plate affixed by the Manufacturer.
requirements.text: The cyber security approval mark shall be placed on or close to the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.

requirements.quote: a = 8 mm min.
requirements.text: The character size of the cyber security approval mark shall be at least 8 mm.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall identify the critical elements of the vehicle type and perform an exhaustive risk assessment for the vehicle type and shall treat/manage the identified risks appropriately.
requirements.text: An exhaustive risk assessment shall be performed for the vehicle type, considering the individual elements and their interactions and the threats listed in Annex 5 Part A, and the identified risks shall be treated and managed appropriately.

requirements.quote: Proportionate mitigations shall be implemented to protect the vehicle type. The mitigations implemented shall include all mitigations referred to in Annex 5, Part B and C which are relevant for the risks identified.
requirements.text: Proportionate mitigations shall be implemented to protect the vehicle type against the risks identified in the risk assessment, including all relevant mitigations referred to in Annex 5 Part B and C or another appropriate mitigation.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall put in place appropriate and proportionate measures to secure dedicated environments on the vehicle type (if provided) for the storage and execution of aftermarket software
requirements.text: Appropriate and proportionate measures shall secure any dedicated environments on the vehicle type for the storage and execution of aftermarket software, services, applications or data.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall perform, prior to type approval, appropriate and sufficient testing to verify the effectiveness of the security measures implemented.
requirements.text: Appropriate and sufficient testing shall be performed prior to type approval to verify the effectiveness of the implemented cyber security measures.

requirements.quote: Detect and prevent cyber-attacks against vehicles of the vehicle type;
requirements.text: The vehicle type shall implement measures to detect and prevent cyber-attacks against vehicles of the vehicle type.

requirements.quote: Provide data forensic capability to enable analysis of attempted or successful cyber-attacks.
requirements.text: The vehicle type shall implement measures to provide data forensic capability enabling analysis of attempted or successful cyber-attacks.

requirements.quote: Cryptographic modules used for the purpose of this Regulation shall be in line with consensus standards.
requirements.text: Cryptographic modules used for the purpose of this Regulation shall be in line with consensus standards, or their use shall be justified by the manufacturer.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall verify the authenticity and integrity of messages it receives
requirements.text: The vehicle shall verify the authenticity and integrity of messages it receives, to protect against spoofing, man-in-the-middle and replay attacks on the communication channels.

requirements.quote: Security controls shall be implemented for storing cryptographic keys (e.g., use of Hardware Security Modules)
requirements.text: Security controls shall be implemented for storing cryptographic keys, e.g. Hardware Security Modules, protecting against their extraction.

requirements.quote: Systems shall implement security by design to minimize risks
requirements.text: Systems shall implement security by design to minimise the risks of code injection and manipulation of vehicle-held data.

requirements.quote: Confidential data transmitted to or from the vehicle shall be protected
requirements.text: Confidential data transmitted to or from the vehicle shall be protected against interception and monitoring.

requirements.quote: Measures to detect and recover from a denial of service attack shall be employed
requirements.text: Measures to detect and recover from a denial-of-service attack shall be employed to protect vehicle functions communicating over the vehicle networks.

requirements.quote: Measures to detect malicious internal messages or activity should be considered
requirements.text: Measures to detect malicious internal messages or activity, such as on the CAN bus, should be considered.

requirements.quote: Secure software update procedures shall be employed
requirements.text: Secure software update procedures shall be employed for over-the-air and local physical software updates of the ALKS.

requirements.quote: Security controls shall be applied to external interfaces
requirements.text: Security controls shall be applied to external interfaces such as the OBD port and other diagnostic or USB interfaces against code injection and manipulation.

requirements.quote: Software shall be security assessed, authenticated and integrity protected.
requirements.text: Software hosted on the vehicle shall be security assessed, authenticated and integrity protected, with controls minimising the risk from third-party software.

requirements.quote: Security controls shall be applied to systems that have remote access
requirements.text: Security controls shall be applied to the vehicle systems that have remote access, protecting against manipulation of remotely operated functions.

requirements.quote: Access control techniques and designs shall be applied to protect system data/code
requirements.text: Access control techniques and designs shall be applied to protect system data and code, including event logs and diagnostic data, against unauthorised modification or erasure.

requirements.quote: Cybersecurity best practices for software and hardware development shall be followed
requirements.text: Cybersecurity best practices for software and hardware development shall be followed, including cybersecurity testing with adequate coverage and no debug ports or development credentials left in production.

requirements.quote: Best practices for the protection of data integrity and confidentiality shall be followed for storing personal data.
requirements.text: Best practices for the protection of data integrity and confidentiality shall be followed for storing personal data in the vehicle.
